# sreagent_outbound_configs (Data Source)

Every outbound_config row, read-only. An escalation target: PagerDuty, Grafana, a webhook, Slack or an on-call schedule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sreagent_outbound_configs" "all" {}

output "outbound_configs_count" {
  value = length(data.sreagent_outbound_configs.all.items)
}
```

- `items` (Attributes List) The rows. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

### Nested Schema for `items`
